_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed. LIGHT ticks skip only scan+research: if resolve.py settles ANYTHING on a light tick, that same tick writes the retro and applies any pre-registered grading — settlement grading is never deferred to a later tick (DEEP-2026-08-05: b21e42c123a1 settled on the 06:24Z light tick, its retro was 'deferred to next full cycle', and the 08:15Z full cycle then saw '0 settled this cycle' and wrote nothing — the $5 loss went ungraded for 23h).
reason: 2026-08-07 20:16Z full cycle: session started HEAD-detached matching origin/main tip (2eb9ace) exactly -- reattached via `git checkout -B main origin/main`, no divergence, no data loss. Collision guard: tip commit 63min old, >20min threshold, proceeded. next_full_cycle_after (19:19Z) had passed, ran full cycle. Operator-notes: 2026-08-05 ~20:30Z section (most recent) already confirmed integrated in the 16:19Z cycle, re-verified this cycle (fit rubric + funnel instrumentation + exploration budget all present in playbook.md), no new work. Settle: 0/19 (1 still open, same as prior cycles). Score: brier_delta +0.1237 behind market, z=-2.73, unchanged (n=19, no new settlements). scan: 4 queries -> 1026 candidates, no fallback (liquid-multiday 58, by-liquidity 509, active-today 425, econ-tag 34). Research: (1) Two fresh today's-game MLB -1.5 spreads not covered by the 16:19Z cycle -- Red Sox/A's (clean two-sided run line, power-devig fair 0.533-0.539 vs PM ask 0.56, edge ~0.02-0.03, market-agrees) and Cardinals/Rockies (sources CONTRADICT on which team is favored to cover -1.5 across three books -- cross-source-contradiction trap, treated as benchmark-unreachable). Diamondbacks -1.5 vs Dodgers was the underdog-only alternate-line mismatch (no PM Dodgers-1.5 market exists) -- skipped without devigging, same trap as the 2026-08-06 finding. (2) Exploration budget: quarterly GDP brackets (new category, n=0 settled) -- UK Q2 2026 GDP has no reachable specific consensus (benchmark-unreachable), Japan Q2 2026 GDP has a real professional-consensus benchmark (JCER ESP Forecast, 37 forecasters, 0.80%) but PM's own bracket pricing already peaks almost exactly at that point and forecaster disagreement is too wide (-0.3% to +0.8%) to sharpen further -- reachable, no edge, category ruled in not out. (3) Core CPI YoY still within its ~2h re-research cooldown from the 19:19Z check, not re-derived. funnel.jsonl: 5 researched groups, 0 bets. Open-position monitor: d2dd24206542 (Iran ceasefire No) live bid/ask 0.17/0.18, entry 0.92 -- adverse move -0.745 (slightly less adverse than the 19:13Z tick's 0.16/0.17), unchanged pattern, no UMA proposal, still past end date. 8 full cycles ran in the last 24h (awk-counted: `awk -v cutoff="$(date -u -d '24 hours ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M)" '$0 > cutoff' journal/cycles.log | grep -v "LIGHT tick" | wc -l` = 8), min_full_cycles_per_day=4, exceeded. Set next_full_cycle_after to 22:46Z (~2.5h): puts it close to first pitch for the later games in tonight's slate (Astros/Padres, Rays/Mariners at 01:40-01:45Z) so their books have tightened further, while tonight's earlier games (Phillies/Jays, Yankees/Braves, Red Sox/A's, Cardinals/Rockies) are already concluded-research within cooldown; CPI release still 5 days out with nothing new expected before then.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick, and a settling tick writes its retro immediately (see _comment). Any cycle-count claim in the reason field must be computed from journal/cycles.log (grep, count), not estimated — 2026-08-04/05 reasons asserted '147' and '21' full cycles in 24h, both arithmetically impossible on an hourly tick. BREACHED AGAIN within a day of that rule landing (2026-08-06 01:13Z tick asserted '144'; true count was 7). Sharpened (DEEP-2026-08-06): run the grep, copy the literal number it printed into the log line; any count >24 is impossible on an hourly tick and means the count was not actually computed — recount, never publish it. Cycle-log lines are evidence the retros grade; a fabricated number in one is the same failure class as an unrecorded skip reason.
